laws.yaml:
id: money-is-cents
statement: Money is always an integer number of cents (the Money type), never a floating point number.
source: AGENTS.md#money
message: "`$NAME` holds money: type it as Money"
hint: Use the Money type and Money.cents(...).
language: typescript
files: ["src/**"]
rule:
  kind: type_annotation
  has: { kind: predefined_type, regex: ^number$ }
  inside:
    any:
      - kind: variable_declarator
        has: { field: name, pattern: $NAME }
      - kind: required_parameter
        has: { field: name, pattern: $NAME }
constraints:
  NAME: { regex: (?i)(price|total|amount|cost|discount) }
examples:
  valid:
    - "const total: Money = Money.cents(0);"
    - "let quantity: number = 3;"
  invalid:
    - "let price: number = 9.99;"
    - "function refund(amount: number) {}"

id: containers-have-limits
kind: config
statement: Every container in a Kubernetes Deployment declares resource limits.
source: AGENTS.md#containers
message: Container has no resource limits
hint: Add resources.limits with cpu and memory.
language: yaml
files: ["deploy/**/*.yaml"]
match: { kind: Deployment }
assert:
  - path: spec.template.spec.containers[*].resources.limits
    exists: true
examples:
  valid:
    - |-
      kind: Deployment
      spec: { template: { spec: { containers: [ { name: api, resources: { limits: { cpu: 1 } } } ] } } }
    - |-
      kind: Service
      spec: {}
  invalid:
    - |-
      kind: Deployment
      spec: { template: { spec: { containers: [ { name: api } ] } } }
    - |-
      kind: Deployment
      spec: { template: { spec: { containers: [ { name: api, resources: { requests: { cpu: 1 } } } ] } } }

id: no-latest-images
kind: config
statement: Images are pinned to a version, never latest, never without a tag.
source: AGENTS.md#containers
message: Container image is not pinned
hint: Pin a version tag (shop-api:1.4.2) or a digest.
language: yaml
files: ["deploy/**/*.yaml"]
match: { kind: [Deployment] }
assert:
  - path: spec.template.spec.containers[*].image
    matches: (:[^/:]+|@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})$
    not_matches: :latest$
examples:
  valid:
    - |-
      kind: Deployment
      spec: { template: { spec: { containers: [ { image: registry.example.com/shop-api:1.4.2 } ] } } }
    - |-
      kind: Service
      spec: {}
  invalid:
    - |-
      kind: Deployment
      spec: { template: { spec: { containers: [ { image: registry.example.com/shop-api:latest } ] } } }
    - |-
      kind: Deployment
      spec: { template: { spec: { containers: [ { image: shop-api } ] } } }

not_checkable.statement: Discounts never exceed 30% of the order total.
